description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a study, with a total of six categories presented. The slices are labeled “Perceptual Error” (purple, 37%), “Lack of Knowledge” (light blue, 9%), “Repeat Thinking and No Answer” (blue, 12%), “Reasoning Error” (pink, 20%), “Correct Answer” (yellow, 15%), and “Choice Format Error” (cyan, 4%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. There is no visible legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
